description: This PHP test class checks the behavior of the FormatWithPurgeTime class, specifically verifying the formatted date returned by getFormattedValue() when given a DateTime object or null. It sets up a mock DateTimeHelperService to control the current date for consistent test results.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeTimeTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the FormatWithPurgeTime class, focusing on its date formatting functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a mock DateTimeHelperService to return a fixed date and creates an instance of FormatWithPurgeTime for testing.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests the getFormattedValue method of FormatWithPurgeTime with both a DateTime object and null input to verify consistent date formatting.
